create_LMSFTConfig: create an LMSFTConfig dataclass to configure supervised fine-tuning for an LM model
customize_LMSFTConfig_optimizer: customize the LMSFTConfig optimizer section to use AdamW with fused implementation and custom learning rate
configure_LMSFTDatasetSection: configure an LMSFTDatasetSection to set sequence length limits, batch size, and shuffle window parameters
set_LMSFTConfig_regime: set the LMSFTConfig regime section to control training steps, validation frequency, and checkpointing schedule
override_LMSFTConfig_dataset_sources: override the LMSFTConfig dataset sources to point to a custom HuggingFace dataset for SFT training
